Commands to interact with data

Usage: dolos data [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  stats         shows storage footprint statistics about the data
  inspect       prints one entity from the state
  dump          prints records from the state, the logs or the blocks
  check         checks the consistency of the managed data
  housekeeping  runs housekeeping tasks, applying the configured history policy
  reset         removes every store under the storage path, keeping the configuration
  rebuild       rebuilds the state store by replaying the local archive
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  
  -h, --help             Print help
